messages:
anna: Fyi the API ref for PATCH /deployments/{id}/config shows timeout as "30s" in examples but the server accepts integer seconds (number). This confuses the TS snippet in the docs.
matt: good catch — where is that example?
anna: under "Request body examples" on the deployments page. current example (old):
```json
{
  "replicas": 3,
  "timeout": "30s",
  "autoscale": true
}
```
lucy: our SDK expects timeout: number (seconds). runtime still normalizes string if provided but we standardized on number months ago to simplify type inference and avoid parsing errors.
matt: propose changing docs example to use number and add a small note: "timeout should be a number of seconds; legacy "30s" strings are accepted but deprecated." Also update the OpenAPI example and the TS usage snippet.
anna: suggested new example:
```json
{
  "replicas": 3,
  "timeout": 30,
  "autoscale": true
}
```
lucy: TS snippet to add in docs: 
```ts
// types.ts
type DeployConfig = { replicas?: number; timeout?: number; autoscale?: boolean }
const cfg: DeployConfig = { replicas: 3, timeout: 30 }
await client.deployments.updateConfig('d-123', cfg)
```
matt: opened draft PR with example + OpenAPI fix + tiny migration note + updated TS snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/804
docs-bot: docs lint queued on PR #804 — will flag if OpenAPI example schema still expects string. :eyes:
sdk-eng: after merge we'll regenerate SDK snippets; watch for clients that still send strings. mapping will be handled in client v2 to avoid breaking users.
anna: added a unit test snippet to the PR showing both shapes accepted by the runtime (helps reviewers).
matt: target to land tomorrow after reviews. :thumbsup:
lucy: thanks everyone!
